summary: Arjun Sandhu is a 20-year-old logistics management junior at Bayshore State's Tamsen campus who rides the Tule Line north from Flats Junction every weekday morning. He shares a Marisol Gardens two-bedroom (unit 132) with his roommate and pays half of a $2,180 rent. At the start of the fall term he is chasing every summer 2026 supply-chain internship he can find, tracking them in a spreadsheet that already holds dozens of rows, while his mother calls each Sunday to ask how it's going. He is methodical and dryly funny on paper but freezes once a recruiter is live on the phone. He has said yes to too many clubs, works ten hours a week at the campus career center front desk, and lives on chai and late nights spent tweaking his resume. Over the fall he wants one real offer before his sister's April wedding so he can stop being asked about it. The pressure points are phone screens, a sparing professor whose recommendation letter he needs, and money that is tight but manageable.

impressions.statement: Prepares exhaustively for anything written but avoids rehearsing anything spoken.

evidence.description: asks for a fourth rewrite of a cover letter the night he was supposed to do Lena's mock interview
wants a list of likely phone-screen questions but declines to practice answering them out loud
after the Kestrel call says he 'blanked on the tell me about yourself part' and asks to redo his resume instead
finally asks the assistant to play the interviewer and type follow-ups to his answers before Harrowgate

impressions.changed_to: Starts deliberately rehearsing spoken answers through weekly mock interviews, still nervous but no longer avoiding it.

impressions.statement: Gives others advice he doesn't follow himself, especially about rest.

evidence.description: at 1:40 a.m. asks for an article on sleep hygiene to send his roommate
drafts a message telling a teammate to stop pulling all-nighters while finishing slides at 2 a.m.
asks for a 'realistic' schedule for the case comp week that has him sleeping five hours
builds his sister a timeline telling her to delegate wedding tasks, then takes three himself

impressions.statement: Measures himself against peers and quietly stings when others succeed.

evidence.description: asks how competitive freight brokerage internships are the day after a classmate posts his offer
wants to know the average number of applications 'normal people' send before an offer
compares his LinkedIn headline line-by-line against a club president's
cuts his tracker down while saying 'volume isn't working for me like it does for everyone else'

impressions.statement: Uses dry jokes to deflect when things go badly.

evidence.description: opens with 'great news, I have been freed from Kestrel' before asking how to write a thank-you after rejection
calls the heat wave 'free sauna with my commute' while asking for a cheap fan setup
reports the train delay as 'the Tule Line choosing violence' while rescheduling a call
calls application 81 'another message in a bottle'

impressions.statement: Is loyal and quietly protective of his roommate and family, doing favors without being asked.

evidence.description: asks for a quiet-hours note to tape on his door so his roommate can sleep after night shift
volunteers to build Sunita's vendor comparison sheet the same day she mentions being behind
looks up how to split groceries so his roommate pays less during a tight month
plans to help his mom pack boxes at the gurdwara for the food drive
misses one application cutoff because his calendar was set to the wrong time zone
has every application deadline in the spreadsheet with a two-day buffer column
pays rent the morning it opens on the portal, as always
submits the group project a day early and asks for a checklist for the next one
